Mr. Vale,

Yes. It was me. I have paid for the house since 1937, through the Ashcroft Trust, because I was forty minutes late and I have never been able to make those forty minutes up.

I walked from the station. Every window was lit. The table was still laid. The tall clock in the library said 2:17 and was not going. I stood where Edmund said I should stand, by the library, and I waited, and nobody came up. Then I ran. I am not proud of it.

The lamp in the turret is for them. Please don't put it out.

I will not come to the house. Don't write again.

E. Orrin
